prompt:
CRITICAL ANTI-TEXT DIRECTIVE: ZERO text of ANY kind. No letters, words, numbers, runes, hieroglyphs, symbols, UI text, watermarks, logos. Use ONLY abstract fracture patterns for decorative markings.

CRITICAL: NO HALO RINGS. No circular discs behind head. No glowing rings.
CRITICAL: NO ANIMALS AT FEET. No companion animals, no creatures. Energy/void patterns only.
CRITICAL: THE HOLLOW IS NOT A PLAYABLE DEITY. This creature must look INCOMPLETE, FRACTURED, CORRUPTED. Where deities radiate divine light, this creature ABSORBS light. Where deities are alive, this creature is ABSENCE. Where deities have faces, this creature has broken or missing masks.
CRITICAL: HOLLOW AESTHETIC — charcoal-black void-stuff body (pure absence given form, NOT metal, NOT stone, NOT flesh). White fracture cracks (cold white lines where light dies, NOT warm energy, NOT fire). Incomplete or broken masks. Broken Gate stone embedded in body (fragments of the original Mythos Gates fused into the form). Negative-space wounds (holes showing ACTIVE NOTHING, the void that consumes). Anti-light seams (absolute black that drinks surrounding light). Ash falling UPWARD (gravity inverts around Hollow creatures).
CRITICAL: NOT EVIL, NOT DEMONIC — the Hollow is EROSION, not malice. It is absence, not corruption with intent. It should feel like looking at a wound in reality, not at a villain. Cold, silent, erasing, not raging or screaming.
CRITICAL: EPIC SCALE — this creature is large but SMALLER than deities. Deities are colossal (hundreds of feet tall). This creature is elite enemy scale (30-50 feet tall). Low camera angle looking up. Show the creature emerging from a Gate fracture or void breach in the ground.
CRITICAL: Readable tactical RPG silhouette — the creature must be readable as a ELITE unit at a glance. Clear weapon or threat indicator. Distinct silhouette from all other Hollow creatures.

Create Hollow Mirror Saint, for Mythos Gates: Ascension. The Hollow threat faction.
Faction: The Hollow (non-playable threat faction).
Threat Tier: Elite.
Creature Category: Hollow Creature.
Combat Role: ELITE.
Canon: The Hollow is the anti-civilization that grows in the wound between Realms. It is what the Mythos Gates were built to keep sealed. When the Gates broke, the Hollow came through. This creature carries fragments of broken Gate stone in its body — not as armor, but as the scar of its own creation. Where deities are alive, this creature is absence. Where deities radiate, this creature absorbs.

ART STYLE: Premium dark mythological tactical RPG enemy concept art. Grim dark aesthetic. The Hollow should feel WRONG — like looking at something that should not exist. Not scary in a monster way, but unsettling in an existential way. This is not a demon or a beast — it is a WOUND IN REALITY wearing a shape it stole from something that was real. Painterly textures, deep shadows, void-black depths.

HOLLOW MIRROR SAINT — A wing-like negative-space guardian with a broken mirror.

BODY: Tall, slender humanoid — 30-35 feet. The body is charcoal-black void-stuff but MORE DEFINED than other Hollow — almost complete, almost beautiful, which makes it MORE WRONG. The form is elegant, symmetric, statue-like — but the symmetry is broken by a massive negative-space wound through the torso. The wound is a perfect mirror shape — an oval void that reflects NOTHING. Looking into the mirror-wound shows not the viewer's reflection, but ACTIVE NOTHING — the absence of reflection.

MASK: Porcelain mask fragments — NOT a single mask, but SHARDS of white porcelain arranged in a rough face shape, floating slightly apart from each other. The shards are from a consumed divine mask (taken from an Empyrean-adjacent culture). Between the shards: void, not skin. The mask fragments orbit slowly, shifting, never quite forming a complete face.

WINGS: Wing-like negative-space formations extend from the back — NOT feathered wings, NOT bat wings, but ABSENCE shaped like wings. The wings are void-shaped, outlined in white fracture cracks, with nothing inside — just the silhouette of wings drawn in absence. The wings do not flap; they hover, frozen in a half-spread position. Anti-light bleeds from the wing-edges.

CHAIN-LIGHT: Cold white chain-light wraps around the arms and torso — NOT warm golden chains, NOT fire, but chains made of anti-light, links of cold white that emit no heat. The chains are not binding — they are ORNAMENTAL, like the vestments of a saint, but made of nothing. The chains pulse faintly, absorbing light.

GATE STONE: A broken mirror-shaped Gate fragment embedded in the forehead area, between the floating mask shards. The fragment is dark glass-like stone, cracked, reflecting nothing. This is the piece of the Mythos Gate that created the Mirror Saint.

POSE: Standing with arms slightly spread, wings half-extended, mirror-wound facing the viewer. The pose is serene, saintly, reverent — and deeply WRONG because of what it is. The Mirror Saint should look like a holy statue that has been hollowed out and filled with nothing. Beautiful and terrifying.

SCALE: 30-35 feet. Low camera angle, looking up at the saint-like form. The Mirror Saint should be the most beautiful Hollow creature — and therefore the most unsettling. Beauty made wrong.

GROUND: The ground around the Mirror Saint is covered in broken mirror fragments — shards of reflective void-stone scattered across the ground, each reflecting nothing. White fracture patterns in geometric, almost religious patterns. Ash falling upward in slow, reverent spirals. The earth looks like the floor of a cathedral that has been erased.

BACKGROUND: Dark void environment that looks like a CATHEDRAL — but wrong. Broken arches, shattered stained-glass windows showing nothing, fallen pillars. The space feels sacred but emptied — like a church where God has been erased. Palette: charcoal-black, porcelain-white, cold white, faint chain-light blue-white, mirror-glass dark.

VFX: Floating mask shards shifting. Mirror-wound reflecting nothing. Anti-light chain-links pulsing. Wing-shaped absence with white fracture edges. Anti-light absorption — the most beautiful light near the Mirror Saint dies the fastest.

SILHOUETTE: Tall, winged, arms spread. Reads as an elite unit — the wing-silhouette and saint-pose are the primary identifiers. Should look like a fallen angel, but NOT an angel — a saint-shaped wound in reality.
